items.title: Steve Turré interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 29, 2021
items.q: They had Yo-Yo Ma. ... But now it’s all about the money.

ctx.x: I should ask you about Saturday Night Live a little bit. I’ve wondered, with all that talent that’s been in and out of that band, when a singer, a pop singer comes on and sings along with pre-recorded music and the band is pretending to play — not your band — but the person’s band. I’m wondering what the musicians think about that? © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

There’s nothing to think. It’s about money. That’s what they’re selling. It’s all about money. They’re selling this image. And you know I was there when Ashlee Simpson messed up and they put the wrong track on and she didn’t know what was going on and ran off the stage. And you know it used to be Saturday night Live. [camera freeze] Or, they tried to do it live, it flopped. And the corporation, I guess NBC got big blowback from these big record companies and mega-corporations that own them, we’ve invested so much…
How much rehearsal goes into one show?
